# Code of Conduct

This project follows a brief Contributor Covenant-style code of conduct.

## Our standards

Participants are expected to be respectful, constructive, and professional.
Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, or abusive behavior are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may remove, edit, or reject contributions and interactions that do not align with these standards.

## Scope

This applies to project spaces (issues, pull requests, discussions, and reviews) and related community interactions.
